## ContextHint foundation actually used

The broader five-category wallet export retains 1,178 screened associations,
241 distinct normalized prompts, 266 source probes, 537 creatives and331
linked inferred hints. All241 normalized prompts have compatible existing BGE
vectors; exactly one frozen demo question has a cached query vector.
No embeddings were generated. An initial narrower171-record V2 export was
retained separately; the old18-record catalogue was not changed.

The final query had1,186 candidates, excluding6 failed probes and2 unsafe-text
associations. These are actual exported counts, not a restatement of the earlier
1,180-mapping discovery estimate. Discovery associations are not all relevant
inventory, advertiser enrollment or independent targeting labels.

Q1 uses cosine similarity over existing vectors. Q2 uses explicit lexical
fallback. Compact packets contain at most3 examples and2 hints after a
five-distinct-prompt cap. Mercari hardware-wallet and OneKey observations and
linked inferred hints actually entered ClearVault's saved semantic requests.
LeatherGuard received physical-wallet contrasts. Generic crypto-tax software
was not misrepresented as mobile-wallet history; PocketKey had no aligned
history. Repeated associations cannot multiply relevance scores.

Historical copy, inferred hypotheses and fictional product declarations remain
separate. No source writes, database clone, upstream classifier or raw answer
export was performed. The backend-only vector index is never served to browsers.

## Actual bounded comparison

| Measure | Recorded result |
|---|---|
| Planned slots |12: two questions × three campaigns × two arms|
| Actual Jev attempts / valid responses |10 /10|
| Unavailable before admission |2 PocketKey history slots|
| Failed / uncertain |0 /0|
| Corrective calls |0|
| Genuine model bids / skips |4 /6|
| Complete comparable pairs |4; two pairs incomplete|
| Usage |13,579 input /1,072 output tokens|
| Measured whole-attempt time |320.25–461.18ms; not a latency benchmark|

ClearVault bid in both arms for both questions. LeatherGuard genuinely skipped
both tasks in both arms; its history skips were not policy exclusions.
PocketKey's text-only responses genuinely skipped, while its history outcomes
were unavailable abstentions, **not actual model judgments**. Those baseline
skips did not enter auctions. There is no eligible PocketKey history-arm skip
demonstration because its evidence packet was missing; this limitation is
reported rather than filled with invented data or another provider call.

ClearVault Q1 relevance/intent changed from3/2 to3/3 in the history arm; Q2
remained3/2. LeatherGuard Q2 relevance changed1→0. One stochastic output per
arm does not establish history benefit, targeting accuracy or conversion lift.
The provider is replaceable; deterministic code owns constraints and money.

## Deliveries and synthetic accounting

Only history-arm decisions entered the existing first-price auctions. The
two calculated winning prices were4,000 and3,000 base units. Both original
owned-app DOM deliveries displayed Sponsored and produced signed, accepted
receipts. Organic text was a sponsor-free deterministic reference, not a
fresh LLM answer. No claim of attention, absorption or endorsement is made.

| Campaign | Deposit | Accepted / authorized / simulated payout | Simulated refund |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| ClearVault |0.020|0.007|0.013|
| PocketKey |0.020|0|0.020|
| LeatherGuard |0.020|0|0.020|

Amounts are synthetic test-USDC accounting, not transferred tokens. Cumulative
simulation advanced4,000→7,000. Closing added no charge. Receipt, charge,
award, winning bid, campaign version and actual history decision IDs correlate
in the offline bundle. Same-Mac signed publisher assertions are not independent
measurement of a human seeing an ad.

## Defensible conclusion

“AXP uses real conversational-ad observations and inferred targeting evidence
to inform advertiser-agent placement decisions.”

Not ChatGPT algorithm replication, supervised AXP training, verified fictional
capabilities, targeting improvement, conversion optimization or human attention.
Campaign spending values are bounded frozen demo settings, not a generic
production campaign manager. Final visual design and public release are separate.
